answer: The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in vault, expire in cipher, and harbor lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 104 aliases therefore needs 120 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 33 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
